metadata.description: A plugin marketplace for Claude Code skills and tools

plugins.name: kroki-plugin
plugins.description: Generate diagrams from plain text using a Kroki server

plugins.name: python-production-versions-plugin
plugins.description: Python production library versions, deprecated packages, and compatibility. Provides version floors with local project overrides.

plugins.name: project-planning-plugin
plugins.description: Structured 4-step methodology for planning and breaking down new software projects

plugins.name: python-cli-scaffold-plugin
plugins.description: Scaffolds Python CLI tools with Click framework and Rich terminal output

plugins.name: python-fastapi-scaffold-plugin
plugins.description: Scaffolds modern Python FastAPI projects with UV, Docker, and K8s support

plugins.name: python-worker-scaffold-plugin
plugins.description: Scaffolds Python background worker projects for RabbitMQ with CloudEvents

plugins.name: sast-plugin
plugins.description: Run a full SAST pipeline across a codebase using Semgrep, Bandit, Trufflehog, and Safety

plugins.name: term-extractor-plugin
plugins.description: Extract technical terms and domain vocabulary from text into structured YAML format

plugins.name: copier-bootstrap-plugin
plugins.description: Bootstrap new projects using Copier templates (FastAPI, RabbitMQ workers, CLI tools, React, AWS Lambda, GCF)

plugins.name: app-to-multiuser-plugin
plugins.description: Reverse-engineer a single-user GUI/Electron app into a PRD + ADR bundle ready for agentic multi-user web implementation

plugins.name: current-github-action-versions-plugin
plugins.description: Current minimum versions of common GitHub Actions to avoid deprecation warnings in workflows

plugins.name: agentic-repo-baseline-plugin
plugins.description: Audit a git repo for the baseline files agents need (README, AGENTS.md, WORKLOG, CHANGELOG, language tooling) and create sensible defaults for the gaps
